title: Ardelyx to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about Ardelyx's business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
WALTHAM, Mass., Sept. 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Ardelyx Inc. (Nasdaq: ARDX), (“Ardelyx” or the “Company”) a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the development and commercialization of innovative medicines that meet significant unmet medical needs, today announced its participation in the following investor conferences:


**Citi's 2026 Biopharma Back to School Conference**
Location: New York, NY
Investor Meetings: Wednesday, September 9


**2026 Cantor Global Healthcare Conference**
Location: New York, NY
Fireside Chat: Thursday, September 10 at 11:30 AM ET
Investor Meetings: Thursday, September 10


**Morgan Stanley 24th Annual Global Healthcare Conference**
Location: New York, NY
Fireside Chat: Wednesday, September 16 at 7:45 AM ET
Investor Meetings: Wednesday, September 16


To access a live webcast of the fireside chats, please visit the Events and Presentations page within the Ardelyx website at[ir.ardelyx.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=NiAUhgADvgBX9L8OMViEcpAy2UDOyIpBH1qgeZmQJ6NaDkX8fsnenCYCLDTTN5jYvKhg3Czh8hQQdjRnelIvb-IO-KahW2vKCg18eQcXl9JS9Xrba7mY0fOPSbt6yKEz) . Replays will be available following the event.


**About Ardelyx, Inc.**
Ardelyx is a commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the development and commercialization of innovative medicines that meet significant unmet medical needs. Ardelyx has two commercial products approved in the United States, IBSRELA® (tenapanor) and XPHOZAH® (tenapanor). The company’s pipeline includes the Phase 3 development of IBSRELA for chronic idiopathic constipation (CIC) and RDX10531, a next-generation NHE3 inhibitor with potential application across multiple therapeutic areas. Ardelyx works with partners to develop and commercialize our products outside of the United States. For more information, please visit[https://ardelyx.com/](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=uZlPWwtPIPGiOLiDeOVVaVwX1lgYNc-I43JufXUuZx4vQ4YXLE8R3mlKHx05IGkt5zgcrEqSdi0_wZoV6KvVK2WTzPeGm0O5FwJr3fcObKw=) and connect with us on[X (formerly known as Twitter)](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=OR446KvI8D5nkCvFv76TSoCTycPjfdZpIvYW5BtvOg2zfv1LegWu2GYxpqxJIGDGRWORBM0MzoA_oahAl8KEEVGA-PkGB7t3GYgPHmMvzF4cm45mqm_V0ObUVNaID6vU) ,[LinkedIn](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=7syM_uBg2GdUIkOBrJFKmlDCA33e2zFT-Y16VkbVIfx1WznKTgKAAUl5XbpT4az-NDD95jMkLUZzmHlDTPpXSFQd2OjckrEJ9KK5ZsoirH8=) and[Facebook](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=ePzmsTqFFeneYZLsdbTr5Wm5bJ1gwBTFWBaDSAqXahDqr9QkuWBzOunRVBd8N9XsEmltUCdKlcQ2TteVmR9vsOTDIONomNivyzfSbWBNIXU=) .
